verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page says its AI agents collect, validate, and package evidence "on your schedule," which implies user-defined recurring evidence-collection jobs. This is only a single marketing phrase with no documented way to configure schedules. Code Security runs a built-in daily scan, but that cadence is fixed, so it does not count as user-scheduled workflows. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable scheduling (cron/intervals, triggers) for jobs or workflows, scheduling available via API/MCP for AI-native use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
